name: Dubey 2007
aliases: Dubey buccal mucosa versus penile skin flap
question: How do dorsal onlay buccal mucosa graft and penile skin flap urethroplasty compare for complex anterior urethral strictures?

arms.label: Dorsal onlay buccal mucosa graft urethroplasty
dorsal onlay penile skin flap urethroplasty

design.population: Fifty-five patients with complex anterior urethral strictures requiring substitution urethroplasty were assigned to dorsal onlay repair.
design.description: Prospective randomized comparison of dorsal onlay substitutions
design.locator: PubMed abstract, Purpose; Materials and Methods

verdictNote: The abstract reports similar success without identifying a prespecified primary endpoint or its threshold.
takeaway: In 55 patients with complex anterior urethral stricture, dorsal onlay buccal mucosa graft and penile skin flap urethroplasty had no reported significant success difference; flap repair took longer and caused more penile morbidity.

reports.label: Randomized comparison
reports.citation: Dubey D, Vijjan V, Kapoor R, et al. Dorsal onlay buccal mucosa versus penile skin flap urethroplasty for anterior urethral strictures: results from a randomized prospective trial. *J Urol.* 2007;178(6):2466-2469. doi:10.1016/j.juro.2007.08.010
reports.followUp: Intermediate follow-up; median duration not stated in abstract

results.measure: Reported success rate; definition and analysis denominators unavailable in abstract
results.note: The reported percentages do not reconcile with the randomized arm sizes (27 and 28); no prespecified primary endpoint or success definition is given.

results.measure: Would recommend the procedure to another patient
results.note: The abstract gives percentages without respondent counts or an assessment timepoint.

harms.label: Troublesome postvoid dribbling
harms.note: The flap percentage printed in the abstract does not reconcile with 9/28 randomized patients (32.1%); the analysis denominator is not supplied. The abstract reports p = 0.001.
